description: This file implements the MessageClient class, which manages message buffers, factories for message deserialization, and message handling in a messaging system within the Thunder::Messaging namespace.

classes.name: MessageClient
classes.description: Manages message buffers, factories, and message processing for inter-component communication.

methods.name: MessageClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MessageClient with identifier, base path, and socket port.

methods.description: Adds a message buffer instance for a given ID.

methods.description: Removes the message buffer instance for a given ID.

methods.name: WaitForUpdates
methods.description: Blocks until updates are available or timeout occurs.

methods.name: SkipWaiting
methods.description: Forces waiting to stop or flushes buffers.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables messages based on metadata.

methods.name: Modules

methods.name: Controls
